{
  "comments": [
    "91f6d0e1: \n ;This routine performs editing and validation of entries in the DATE/TIME\n ;TRANSCRIBED field (#10.05) of the SURGICAL CASE/OPERATION file (#393).\n ;It is called from the SURGICAL CASE/OPERATION file's DD and from\n ;routine DGJXE14.\n ;",
    "8d484868: ;Calls the DIC editor initialization code",
    "bb950e4c: ;Sets file-related variables for the SURGICAL CASE/OPERATION file\n;and performs builds related to the DATE/TIME DICTATED field (#10.03)",
    "0fc1219f: ;If the DATE/TIME DICTATED field is populated, stores the DATE SIGNED\n;value from that field in the local variable DE(1)",
    "ee0f42f8: ;Kills the local variable %Z",
    "6e43d4b7: ;Writes a prompt showing the field label and colon",
    "070c3627: ;Exit point",
    "c064b6ca: ;Calls the reader to get user input",
    "24a83c32: ;If the user response is longer than 19 characters and the DATA TYPE\n;is not WORD-PROCESSING, display a message and branch to the reader",
    "77675e1b: ;If the field is READ-ONLY and is INVERSE-VIDEO, set X to null and\n;display a 'No Editing' message",
    "6f628945: ;Reads user input, sets TIMEOUT if applicable, and issues beep for\n;up-arrow or other non-ResponseControl characters",
    "1f59404d: ;Exit point",
    "be728a66: ;Increments the DQ counter used for branching",
    "27854c34: ;Branches to the label represented by DQ",
    "bab2679c: ;If data already exists for this field, branches to restore\n;the existing value, otherwise calls the reader",
    "2d6446b3: ;If input is blank, go to the next input field if required, set X to null if not required, set X to null if required and the datatype does not require an answer, go to the next input field.",
    "833a22ce: ;If input begins with '?', branch to the QS code which handles additional reader input.",
    "6534e9bc: ;If input is '@', branch to the delete data routine.",
    "4292d75f: ;If input is ' ' (space) and the DIWP field has a default value defined for the user, set X to that value as long as DV does not expect a date or set-of-codes value.",
    "dff32ccf: ;If DV is set, branch to validity checking routine. If DV contains 'V', branch to the variable pointer routine. If DV contains 'S', set X to the external value found in DD(file#,field#,12.1) node. Set Y to the internal value and execute any additional input validation in DIC(\"S\"). If DB(DQ) is undefined, write out the external value. Branch to the V code.",
    "80fe24c6: ;Cycle through each ';' piece of the set-of-codes value looking for a match with the user's input. If a match is found, execute any additional input validation in DIC(\"S\"). Quit the loop if a match is found.",
    "fb5d004e: ;If DB(DQ) is undefined, write out the remnants of the set-of-codes piece after the matched user input.",
    "8192cc5a: ;If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the starting point for Fileman lookup and DIC(0) flags. If DV contains a 'P' value, set DLAYGO to that value. If DV does not contain '*', branch to the Fileman lookup routine. Set X to the internal value returned and reset DIC to the original value. Branch to the X code if X is less than 0.",
    "7be99933: ;If DV does not contain 'N', branch to the D code. If the value of X is greater than 24 characters, set X to null and branch to the Z code.",
    "7188fdde: ;If DV contains a ',' value and X contains a decimal point and the input field is not a dollar amount, remove leading zeros and trailing zeros after the decimal point. If the decimal value is null, set X to an integer.",
    "c9e89f58: ;Execute the code at the current DQ position.",
    "bd6e85b6: ;Kill off any residual values from Fileman lookup. If X is not null, save it in the global DG array. If DV contains 'd', also save in DIWP global for the current user/field.",
    "009383df: ;Write '??' to let the user know their input was invalid. If DB(DQ) is defined, branch to the reset routine.",
    "75df8305: ;Set X to '?BAD' for an invalid input value.",
    "5313d5d0: ;Set DZ to the invalid input value. Branch to the D code to set other DQ(DQ) values. Branch to QQ^DIEQ to handle reader input of '?'.",
    "6b8ab585: ;Build input record for FileMan call.",
    "942131c0: ;If no DE array element then get input if not read-only or '@'.",
    "d56bf501: ;If DE array element then use it.",
    "f069e59b: ;If a pointer to a file find the .01 field value.",
    "f07bdb6f: ;If a pointer to a multiply-valued field find the value.",
    "5a6c8faa: ;If a set of codes/ran then piece out the value.",
    "560da793: ;If return answer.",
    "c314035d: ;If not inid or date/time then get input.",
    "f1d16f7c: ;If inid or date/time input.",
    "7cced0fd: ;Quit.",
    "a30bfa90: ;Main entry point for routine.",
    "780cd545: ;Field attributes for DATE SIGNED field.",
    "a88fe71e: ;Go to FileMan.",
    "eef01f63: ;Extrinsic function to compute DATE SIGNED value.",
    "e6d44edf: ;Quit from extrinsic function.",
    "5427ea7d: ;This line sets the primary input variable X to null.",
    "cfd9cccd: ;If the input X is null, this line clears the DATE SIGNED field in the record.",
    "4fba6844: ;Ends the code block for handling null input.",
    "78ebe037: ;This line sets the primary input variable X to null.",
    "4db3333b: ;If the input date is earlier than the DATE DICTATED field, this displays an error message and clears the DATE SIGNED field.",
    "3f31ed81: ;Ends the code block for handling date validation.",
    "e1195c90: ;This line sets the primary input variable X to null.",
    "6a28cdae: ;If the input X is null, this sets the DGJTST variable to 'TRANSCRIBED' and the secondary input variable Y to '@2'.",
    "f46425ab: ;Ends the code block for handling null input.",
    "0b174af3: ;This transfers control to the DGJXE14 routine."
  ]
}
